calculators.formula_explanation: Calculates Indonesia Personal Income Tax (PPh 21) under UU Harmonisasi Peraturan Perpajakan (HPP) and Government Regulation PP 58/2023 / PMK 168/2023 TER (Tarif Efektif Rata-Rata) withholding scheme. 1. Annual Gross Income = (Monthly Gross Salary * 12) + Annual Bonus/THR. 2. Deductions: Biaya Jabatan = Min(5% * Annual Gross Salary, Rp 6,000,000). 3. Annual Net Income = Annual Gross Income - Biaya Jabatan. 4. Chargeable Income (PKP - Penghasilan Kena Pajak) = Max(0, Annual Net Income - PTKP Amount). 5. UU HPP Annual Tax Brackets: First Rp 60,000,000 @ 5%; Next Rp 190,000,000 (Rp 60,000,001 to Rp 250,000,000) @ 15%; Next Rp 250,000,000 (Rp 250,000,001 to Rp 500,000,000) @ 25%; Next Rp 4,500,000,000 (Rp 500,000,001 to Rp 5,000,000,000) @ 30%; Portion exceeding Rp 5,000,000,000 @ 35%. Non-NPWP penalty adds 20% to final tax liability for non-TER regular calculations. 6. Monthly Withholding TER Category: Category A (TK/0, TK/1, K/0); Category B (TK/2, TK/3, K/1, K/2); Category C (K/3). Monthly TER rate is applied directly to monthly gross income for months 1-11, with month 12 reconciling the annual progressive tax.

calculators.formula_explanation: Calculates monthly net take-home salary and statutory employer/employee social security contributions under Law No. 24 of 2011 (BPJS) and labor regulations. 1. Employee BPJS Deductions: BPJS Kesehatan = 1% * Min(Monthly Base Salary, Rp 12,000,000); BPJS JHT (Jaminan Hari Tua) = 2% * Monthly Base Salary (no cap); BPJS JP (Jaminan Pensiun) = 1% * Min(Monthly Base Salary, Rp 10,042,300). 2. Employer BPJS Contributions: BPJS Kesehatan = 4% * Min(Monthly Base Salary, Rp 12,000,000); BPJS JHT = 3.7% * Monthly Base Salary; BPJS JP = 2% * Min(Monthly Base Salary, Rp 10,042,300); BPJS JKK = Selected Risk Rate (0.24% to 1.74%) * Monthly Base Salary; BPJS JK (Jaminan Kematian) = 0.30% * Monthly Base Salary. 3. Monthly Tax Deduction (PPh 21 TER): Calculated based on monthly gross taxable salary applied against PMK 168/2023 TER withholding tables for Category A, B, or C. 4. Net Monthly Salary (Take-Home Pay) = Monthly Base Salary - Employee BPJS Kesehatan - Employee JHT - Employee JP - Monthly PPh 21 TER Tax. Total Employer Cost of Employment = Monthly Base Salary + Employer BPJS Total.

calculators.formula_explanation: Calculates employee termination compensation under Government Regulation PP No. 35 Year 2021 (implementing Law No. 11/2020 & Perppu 2/2022 Job Creation / UU Cipta Kerja) and Final PPh 21 tax withholding rules. 1. Base Severance Pay (Uang Pesangon - UP): Service < 1 year = 1 month wage; 1 to <2 years = 2 months; 2 to <3 years = 3 months; 3 to <4 years = 4 months; 4 to <5 years = 5 months; 5 to <6 years = 6 months; 6 to <7 years = 7 months; 7 to <8 years = 8 months; >= 8 years = 9 months. Base UP is multiplied by the specific termination reason factor (0.5x, 1.0x, 1.75x, or 2.0x). 2. Service Recognition Pay (Uang Penghargaan Masa Kerja - UPMK): Service < 3 years = 0; 3 to <6 years = 2 months; 6 to <9 years = 3 months; 9 to <12 years = 4 months; 12 to <15 years = 5 months; 15 to <18 years = 6 months; 18 to <21 years = 7 months; 21 to <24 years = 8 months; >= 24 years = 10 months. UPMK is multiplied by the termination reason factor (typically 1.0x). 3. Rights Compensation Pay (Uang Penggantian Hak - UPH): (Unused Annual Leave Days / Working Days per Month) * Monthly Wage + Relocation/Repatriation Cost. 4. Gross Severance Package = Adjusted UP + Adjusted UPMK + UPH. 5. Final Tax on Severance (PPh 21 Final atas Pesangon): First Rp 50,000,000 @ 0%; Rp 50,000,001 to Rp 100,000,000 @ 5%; Rp 100,000,001 to Rp 500,000,000 @ 15%; Amount exceeding Rp 500,000,000 @ 25%. Net Severance Received = Gross Severance Package - Final Tax.

calculators.formula_explanation: Calculates small business and freelancer income tax liabilities under Government Regulation PP 55/2022 (replacing PP 23/2018) and DGT Regulation PER-17/PJ/2015 for Net Income Calculation Norms (NPPN). 1. Individual MSME (WP OP UMKM): Under PP 55/2022, gross annual revenue up to Rp 500,000,000 is 100% EXEMPT from income tax. Any gross turnover above Rp 500,000,000 (up to the Rp 4.8 Billion annual ceiling) is taxed at 0.5% Final PPh rate. 2. Corporate MSME (CV/PT): 0.5% Final PPh applies directly to 100% of gross annual turnover without the Rp 500,000,000 exemption. 3. Independent Freelancer / Professional (NPPN): Net Income = Annual Gross Revenue * Applicable NPPN Rate (typically 50% for 10 major provincial capitals like Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung). Chargeable Income (PKP) = Max(0, Net Income - Selected PTKP Amount). Income tax is computed using UU HPP progressive tax brackets (5% up to 60M, 15% 60M-250M, 25% 250M-500M, 30% 500M-5B, 35% >5B).

calculators.formula_explanation: Calculates property acquisition taxes and legal fees for real estate transactions in Indonesia under Law No. 1 of 2022 (HKPD), Government Regulation PP 34/2016, and ATR/BPN Ministry Regulation No. 33/2021. 1. Base Property Valuation (NPOP - Nilai Perolehan Objek Pajak): Higher of Transaction Price or Government NJOP Value. 2. Buyer Tax (BPHTB - Bea Perolehan Hak atas Tanah dan Bangunan): Taxable NPOP (NPOPKP) = Max(0, NPOP - Selected Region NPOPTKP). BPHTB Payable = NPOPKP * 5%. 3. Seller Tax (PPh Final Pengalihan Hak atas Tanah dan/atau Bangunan): 2.5% of Gross NPOP. 4. Notary / PPAT Fee (Biaya Akta Jual Beli - AJB): NPOP * Selected PPAT Rate (0.5% to 1.0%) + 11% PPN (VAT) on service fee. 5. BPN Certificate Title Transfer Administrative Fee (PNBP Balik Nama Sertifikat): PNBP = (NPOP / 1,000) + Rp 50,000 + Rp 50,000 (Title Verification). Total Upfront Buyer Cash Required = Transaction Price + BPHTB + PPAT Fees + PNBP Balik Nama. Net Cash Received by Seller = Transaction Price - Seller PPh Final (2.5%) - Seller Agent/Legal Fees.
